evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: We actually got your quotation request so we just need to ask you some questions about it might take about 10–15 minutes if this is a good time. [No wait for explicit yes; rushed past.]
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep jumps directly into probing: 'But of course before I start do you have any special concerns or instructions for this move' — this is a yes/no gate, not 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns.'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: items (armwall, mattress, headboard), weight (300–500 lbs), dimensions (4 ft wide, 3.5–4 ft deep, 6.5 ft tall), stairs (one 3–4 inch step), walking distance estimate (23 school buses ≈100 ft), elevator access. Not explicitly covered: property type, floor/stories, number of rooms (inferred partial), special considerations covered for armwall only.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Customer said 'I can move the other small stuff in my car' and rep accepted; no packing ask.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Range given ($505 for 2.5 hrs, $505–$606 for 2.5–3 hrs) but no typical-home-size anchor. Personalized only to the armwall weight concern and storage walk. No framing of 'typical for a home this size.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: All-inclusive disclosure present ('everything is already in that price'). Trip/overnight/materials fees not explicitly called out upfront. 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increments framing present. Partial: missing upfront trip/overnight fee transparency.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep pivots directly to the explicit ask ('would you like our help for this move') without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or holding silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered: 'if we run late on the time we schedule we provide discounts by the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial: '$2,000 coverage for any repair, replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages' mentioned, but does not include 'no deductible / no fine print' framing or explicit 'built into the rate, not an add-on' language.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. No version of 'Does that put those to rest?' asked. Rep mentions features in bulk but does not close the loop explicitly.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. No 'What's still concerning you about this move?' Rep jumps to explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep asks 'would you like our help for this move on Monday or on that 19th of October?' but customer responds 'I'm getting a price from one other company. So let me get back with you once I hear from them.' Rep does not rephrase as a direct ask or attempt to close; instead accepts and pivots to comparison messaging.

top_strength: Thorough logistics probing on the armwall — weight, dimensions, stairs, walking distance, elevator access — with clear follow-up questions that ensured an accurate, personalized estimate despite the unusual item.
coaching_note: Section 2 was skipped entirely: ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move and what do you want answers to on this call?' before probing, and the customer will tell you what matters most to them rather than you guessing (and you can reflect it back at the end to confirm).
booking_note: Customer said 'I'm getting a price from one other company. So let me get back with you once I hear from them.' - no commitment to book was made.
